articles.title: Canada Permanently Excludes Mental Disorders From Assisted Dying Criteria
articles.summary: Canada's federal administration announced Wednesday it will introduce a bill to permanently bar individuals from receiving physician-assisted death if psychological illness is their only underlying health issue. The measure seeks to resolve ongoing debates surrounding access eligibility.
